verdict.rationale: Belvo's docs mention 'asynchronous real-time POST calls (both single and recurrent links)' and POST calls that retrieve link information, which points to an API-triggered, on-demand data pull alongside the automatic weekly refresh for recurrent links. The evidence never explicitly frames this as an on-demand refresh or explains how it behaves. Missing for 10: an explicit refresh endpoint description, documented refresh semantics (what gets re-fetched, timing, rate or frequency limits, how it interacts with the weekly recurrent refresh), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
